checks: Repeated debug/release profiles and compiled mutation receipts in model.md#tests
cost: O(n) validation plus partition lookup O(log n); only neighboring secants/slopes evaluated; O(1) stack, no allocation/callback.
description: Sorted 2..64 nodes in [-1,1], gaps >=1e-8, finite |y|<=1e100, hull query. Interior derivative is weighted harmonic mean of adjacent secants when nonzero and same sign, zero otherwise. Endpoint uses one-sided derivative then sign/3*secant clipping. Cubic Hermite basis evaluates the selected segment. Size, nonfinite, domain, spacing then arithmetic precedence. Two nodes give linear interpolation; exact node returns stored y.
